description: Checkout links (SPEC.md §30, Checkout links). `origins`: the checkout origin a channel's `checkout` field gives (null: none). `derivations`: a link key's address and encryption key. `urls`: a link's URL. `fragments`: what a URL's fragment names: a link (`author`, `linkKey`, `relays`), "newer" (a newer format), "invalid", or "other" (not a checkout link). `records`: what the page shows of a record's value (its sats, the invoice's payment hash (null without one), its on-chain address (null without one), its end, what it shows of the redirect URL, and the rest author and rest key of a record of version 2 that carries them, else null), "newer" or "invalid".

fragments.name: nine characters: not a checkout link
an upper case marker: not a checkout link
a payment link of the point of sale
a character of base64, not base64url

records.name: a link of the real invoice
version 2: an invoice and an address
version 2: the rest author and the rest key
version 2: a rest key without its author
version 2: a rest author without its key
version 2: a rest author that is no point of the curve
version 2: a rest key in upper case
version 2: a rest key of 31 bytes
version 2: an amount that is not the invoice's
version 2: a date that is not the invoice's
version 2: an end that is not the invoice's
version 2: an address in upper case
version 2: no invoice, but a verify URL
version 2: an end before its date
a business name of ASCII whitespace (space, tab, line feed, carriage return)
a business name of a form feed: not ASCII whitespace
a verify URL on an IP address
a verify URL with its host in upper case
a note with a line feed
a note holding a lone surrogate
a note holding a pair of surrogates (an emoji)
a redirect URL to a wallet
